dict.string: Storagelyzer measures how much space the files on your Desktop take up. Nothing is uploaded or changed.
Storagelyzer measures how much space your Documents take up. Nothing is uploaded or changed.
Storagelyzer measures how much space your Downloads take up. Nothing is uploaded or changed.
Storagelyzer measures how much space is used on removable drives you choose to scan.
Storagelyzer measures how much space is used on network volumes you choose to scan.
